testingVerificationStrategy.result: Mapped Browser SQL contracts to Node deterministic tests, real Chromium Worker/Wasm/OPFS/runtime/Viewer integration tests and authenticated-Leumi live verification for real page CSP/origin/provider behavior.
testingVerificationStrategy.criticalLiveGate: Before heavy Browser SQL implementation, prove on the real authenticated Leumi page with synthetic data: injected JS/Bookmarklet → Blob Worker → pinned DuckDB Worker/Wasm → OPFS write+COMMIT+CHECKPOINT → refresh/reopen.
testingVerificationStrategy.ci: Fast Node CI remains normal push/PR gate; targeted Chromium is used during browser TDD/debugging; full Browser CI is required for browser-dependent Stage closure and runtime publication.

next.action: Planning Phase N: design migration and cutover from the current IndexedDB baseline to Browser SQL.
steps: Define coexistence phases without allowing two permanent market-history authorities.
Decide whether existing IndexedDB history is imported, retained read-only as legacy, or intentionally not migrated based on product value and complexity.
Define cutover prerequisites including live Leumi compatibility, pinned-engine OPFS reopen verification, functional Browser CI and benchmark gates.
Define rollback/fallback behavior that does not silently switch authorities.
Define generated runtime/version transition and cleanup of obsolete IndexedDB/Browser SQL migration scaffolding.
